PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
No. 1939/19 – WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 04, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: TAWILA/3/4/4/3-1. Land Min’s No.: 4/3/7/2012/HW/205.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a Broaden the part of road from 5+000KM to 9+500KM of Lunugamwehera-Beralihela-Katharagama Road.
Description of the land to be acquired:

Allotements of land in F. T. P. No. 74 Suppliment No. 8 Sheet No. 22 prepared by the superintend sureveyor in Moneragala, situated in Seenukkuwa village in the Thanamalwila Divisional Secretary’s division of the district of Monaragala in Uva Province described as follows.
